songs.title: MS.WATUMACALLIT
songs.verdict: A quick two-minute cut that flips between sung hooks and her raspy Bronx delivery over a futuristic rav3nradio beat.
songs.body:
Baby Osamaa is a South Bronx rapper blending pluggnb, sexy drill and sample drill, a FADER and Pitchfork favorite since 2024.
The track comes from her six-song self-released EP ON THA RUN.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. Out Oct 28, 2026 on ON THA RUN EP (Tank Girl Records, indie; earlier album via Roc Nation Distribution). FADER Songs You Need Nov 4, 2026 (https://thefader.com/2026/11/04/songs-you-need-in-your-life-november-4-2026); YouTube from that embed (scout's direct fetch returned odd metadata, click to confirm). Audiomack song: https://audiomack.com/whereisosama/song/mswatumacallit. Doubt: may be over 100k monthly; passes on no-major-deal.

songs.title: all the boys
songs.verdict: A synth-heavy, deliberately sleazy follow-up from the Brooklyn rapper whose remix became a slow-burn internet hit.
songs.body:
Sterling Cupid is an Atlanta-born, Crown Heights-based alt-rap/pop artist whose 'only one (ghettopop remix)' got an ILoveMakonnen remix.
This follow-up single arrived as FADER named him to its 2026 'New York Is' class.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. Out Oct 27, 2026 on FADER Label (indie) per Shazam (https://www.shazam.com/song/6823400866/all-the-boys). Sources: https://www.thefader.com/2026/10/28/songs-you-need-in-your-life-october-28-2026 ; https://www.thefader.com/2026/11/10/new-york-is-2026-class. Spotify artist: https://open.spotify.com/artist/5KJkkVnNOffPDnPfHrunki (no track link found). Check listener count.

songs.title: Immaculate
songs.verdict: A confident comeback built around a huge, reverb-soaked hook over intense Blake Wright production.
songs.body:
Jean Deaux is a Chicago rapper-singer working an independent alt-rap and cloud-rap lane.
The single is a statement of creative independence and the first of a promised run of new releases.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. Out Sep 25, 2026 (Playbook Distribution, independent). FADER Songs You Need Sep 30 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/09/30/songs-you-need-in-your-life-september-30-2026); Clash (https://www.clashmusic.com/news/jean-deaux-returns-electrified-with-new-single-immaculate/). YouTube left blank: FADER and Clash embed different videos (V7AwiC1kKBQ vs PFUv0fIQZq4). Has a Wikipedia page; check listener count.

songs.title: STATIC. (feat. Joey Bada$$ & Nali)
songs.verdict: Reviewers picked this sample-heavy, trumpet-laced confessional as the high point of his new album.
songs.body:
Ovrkast. is an Oakland rapper-producer known for jazz-leaning loop beats, with a production credit on Drake's 'Make Them Pay'.
The track, from his independent album STRIKING, has a Joey Bada$$ verse and a soft Nali outro.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. Album STRIKING out Oct 9, 2026, independent (https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/1012507-striking-ovrkast). Spotify track from Stereofox embed (https://www.stereofox.com/ovrkast-static-ft-joey-bada-nali/); Apple is the album. RGM review 4.5/5 (https://ratingsgamemusic.com/2026/10/10/ovrkast-striking-album-review/). Doubt: listeners may be near/over 100k.

songs.title: Vampire Hunter D
songs.verdict: Anime-referencing boom bap with crisp drums, swirling strings and scratches, all produced by The1FS himself.
songs.body:
The1FS is a NYC visual artist, producer and composer with work for GTA and Adult Swim; MoonChld Washington handles the vocals.
The track borrows its name and imagery from the Vampire Hunter D anime franchise.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (NYC underground boom bap). buffaBLOG Nov 2, 2026 (https://buffablog.com/the1fs-vampire-hunter-d/); Spotify from that embed. Exact release date not stated (late Oct/early Nov). Both look very small.

songs.title: TOWN IN TEXAS
songs.verdict: A moody breakup song that swings between rapping and singing over his own melancholy guitar.
songs.body:
Alex Vince is a Maryland-born, LA-based rapper, singer, producer and guitarist.
The song is set in a small West Texas town, inspired by a solo drive, and ends with him choosing the open road.
songs.scout_note: Rap/alt-rap lane, leans country-tinged sung rap; check fit. Ratings Game Music Oct 30, 2026 (https://ratingsgamemusic.com/2026/10/30/alex-vince-town-in-texas-review/) and buffaBLOG Nov 2 (https://buffablog.com/alex-vince-town-in-texas/), both embed this Spotify track; IG from buffaBLOG. Exact date ~late Oct. Very small.

songs.title: Trace me on2 u
songs.verdict: A glitchy electro-house pop single from a Bandcamp-native act, aimed at the clubby end of hyperpop.
songs.body:
Touching Ice is an independent electronic-pop project releasing through Bandcamp and SoundCloud.
This standalone single sets glitch-pop vocals over electro-house and techno drums, with a music video.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Out Oct 22, 2026. Links from the release listing at https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct (scout could not open the platform pages; spot-check one). Looks small.

songs.title: ghc: girls hyperflip cry!!!
songs.verdict: A maximalist, mashup-brained record that hurls dariacore, bubblegum bass and electro house at the wall.
songs.body:
flipEMoff!! is an underground hyperpop/dariacore producer releasing via the lostfrog Bandcamp label.
The album goes for rapid-fire glitch pop and deconstructed-club chaos.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Out Oct 24, 2026, Bandcamp/SoundCloud only. Links from listing at https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct (not opened directly). Album; pick a lead track.

songs.title: c
songs.verdict: A hazy digicore and hexd record riding rage and trap drums, squarely in the post-SoundCloud internet-rap lane.
songs.body:
Lucy Bedroque is an underground digicore artist with a strong SoundCloud following.
The album blends digicore, hexd, rage and trap; 'Speed Demon' got a video.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop/digicore lane. Out Sep 17, 2026. YouTube is the 'Speed Demon' video. Listing: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-sept-14th-2026-sept (links not opened directly). Doubt: may be near/over 100k monthly, check.

songs.title: Mixtape Cult Vol. 3: The World Meets Brazil
songs.verdict: A São Paulo club mixtape where Brazilian funk energy collides with hyperpop and experimental pop guests.
songs.body:
GP DA ZL is a São Paulo DJ and producer from the Brazilian funk and club underground.
The third Mixtape Cult volume pairs Brazilian club rhythms with hyperpop and experimental-pop collaborators.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop/club lane. Out Sep 17, 2026. Listing: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-sept-14th-2026-sept (links not opened directly). Mixtape; pick a track. Listener count unknown.

songs.artist: Zoë Mc Pherson feat. Jay Mitta
songs.title: 3OK
songs.verdict: A hyper-rhythmic meeting of Dar es Salaam singeli and experimental club built to hit like a breakcore sprint.
songs.body:
Zoë Mc Pherson is an experimental electronic artist on SVBKVLT; Jay Mitta is a singeli producer from Sisso Studios in Dar es Salaam.
The project grew out of a Nyege Nyege residency built on fast finger-drumming improvisation.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Out Oct 29, 2026 on SVBKVLT (SBKT079). Listing: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-26th-2026-nov ; background https://www.disk-agency.de/works/3ok. Links not opened directly.

songs.title: Catedral Gótica
songs.verdict: A Príncipe collaboration that drifts Lisbon batida roots into ambient, IDM and techno space, more head than floor.
songs.body:
A.k.Adrix is a Lisbon-scene producer and Niagara a Portuguese electronic act, teaming up on Príncipe Discos.
The album blends ambient, IDM and techno with batida rhythms; A.k.Adrix released a solo LP the same day.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Out Oct 30, 2026 on Príncipe Discos. Listing: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-26th-2026-nov (links not opened directly).

songs.title: You Move
songs.verdict: Shimmering, saxophone-tinged indie rock that reaches for widescreen rather than lo-fi.
songs.body:
Avery Friedman is a Cleveland-raised, Brooklyn-based singer-songwriter on UK indie label Audio Antihero.
The single sets glistening guitars and pulsing drums against saxophone.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Out Oct 9, 2026. Atwood Weekly Roundup Oct 16 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/wr-roundup-2026-10-16-1/); YouTube from that embed. Small indie label; listeners not checked.

songs.title: Hear Me Out
songs.verdict: A feverish indie rock single folding 90s alt grit, shoegaze haze and dream-pop sweetness together.
songs.body:
Dutch Mustard is a Dutch-born, London-based artist self-releasing on her own DM Records.
The song is a fuzzed-out indie anthem softened by dream-pop melody.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Out Sep 15, 2026 (edge of window). Atwood Weekly Roundup Oct 16 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/wr-roundup-2026-10-16-1/); YouTube from that embed. Self-released; listeners not checked.

songs.title: Dovetail
songs.verdict: Warm analogue synths and distorted backing vocals push this toward the space between bedroom pop and neo-soul.
songs.body:
ANT ENOCH is an Australian singer-songwriter who debuted in 2024 with the EP Big Talk Big Party.
The single was co-produced with Chris Hyson (Jordan Rakei) around vintage synths and a rounded bassline.
songs.scout_note: Bedroom/alt-pop lane. Out Oct 8, 2026 via Embassy of Music (indie). Atwood Weekly Roundup Oct 12 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/wr-roundup-2026-10-12/); YouTube from that embed. Listeners not checked.

songs.title: The Change in Me
songs.verdict: Wry, jangly indie art-pop about climate dread and personal anxiety, previewing a debut solo album.
songs.body:
Michael Cook is a Newcastle upon Tyne singer-songwriter and guitarist with solo album Borderland due in January.
The single is jangle-pop about coping with the state of the planet.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Obscure Sound Nov 11, 2026 (https://www.obscuresound.com/2026/11/michael-cook-the-change-in-me/); Spotify from that embed. Exact release date not given; common name, confirm the Spotify profile. Very small.

songs.title: Social Skills
songs.verdict: A DIY Istanbul artist turns darker and more direct, with moody alt-R&B about social masks and people-pleasing.
songs.body:
Atomic Cherry is Ece, an independent Istanbul artist who writes, sings, produces, mixes and masters her own music.
Her second single previews an EP and moves from hazy alt-pop toward soulful hip-hop.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK Nov 3, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/11/03/atomic-cherry-turns-social-masks-and-people-pleasing-into-a-statement-on-social-skills/); Spotify from that embed. Exact date not given (~early Nov). IG from the EARMILK press post. Tiny.

songs.title: Lowells
songs.verdict: A producer-led alt-R&B mood piece setting MARO's soft vocal over moody piano and driving drums.
songs.body:
WYNNE is the project of Grammy-nominated songwriter-producer Rory Andrew (ODESZA, Jessie Murph); MARO is a Portuguese indie-pop artist.
The track builds atmosphere from layered piano and propulsive drums.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Out Oct 2, 2026. Atwood Weekly Roundup Oct 12 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/wr-roundup-2026-10-12/); YouTube from that embed. Doubt: established producer and MARO has a Eurovision profile; check WYNNE's listeners/label before treating as underground.

songs.title: Melody 001
songs.verdict: Free-flowing jazz piano over a trip-hop beat, skipping conventional song structure entirely.
songs.body:
Aauna is an independent artist with an EP on the way; little other background is public.
The track is about finding hope in everyday chaos.
songs.scout_note: R&B/experimental lane. EARMILK Nov 10, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/11/10/aauna-finds-direction-through-experimental-sound-on-new-release-melody-001/); Spotify from that embed. Exact date not given. IG from the EARMILK press post. Very small.
